dependency_semantics: Every dependency names a work package and a milestone: B is frozen software baseline, S is software readiness. WP15:S never waits for H/P; WP16 institutional integration waits for WP15:S and actual traffic additionally requires the selected business line's WP15:H. WP12-A can start after WP06:S/WP07:S.

storage.implementation_requirement: Only the approved plan, acceptance ledger, frozen requirements and implementation record are explicitly unignored; historical superpowers files remain ignored.

closure_rules: Every required evidence tier must have original evidence tied to commit, input and criterion versions.
Fixture, mock, skipped, missing or unknown evidence cannot satisfy a real execution tier.
Partial software or historical acceptance does not close an item requiring production evidence.
Unknown or unidentifiable business facts must be detected and bounded; they must not be invented.
Do not remove failures, change denominators or weaken required scope to close a finding.
All findings closed and independent review passed are required for overall completion.

Mature production outcomes and identifiable experiment evidence where causal claims are required

findings.title: 真实模型与真实工具的完整任务证据不足
findings.closure_criterion: 冻结任务集经真实入口完成联合评测；保留失败分母、干预、成本和置信区间。

findings.title: expected 输入污染与模拟完成口径混用
findings.closure_criterion: expected 隔离反例通过；契约、盲测和真实执行结果分开，fixture 不可满足真实执行门槛。

findings.title: 流程完成与业务达标混用
findings.closure_criterion: 执行、业务验收、审批状态独立；缺标准、缺证据、错采用对象不产生业务通过。

findings.title: 数据准备到训练缺少强制时间正确性契约
findings.closure_criterion: 时点与修订规则贯通；穿越负例正确阻断；未知历史可得性明确不可证明且不被补造。

findings.title: 情景假设与实际增量收益证据不足
findings.closure_criterion: 假设、观察、可识别增量效果分开；成熟结果正确对账；无法识别时不输出因果收益。

findings.title: 默认监控装配不完整
findings.closure_criterion: 标准入口可执行已配置监控与通知；水位、调度和送达有实际证明，机构环境独立验证。

findings.title: 生产激活与回滚缺运行环境闭环
findings.closure_criterion: 目标环境真实切换与回滚并读回；外部成功本地失败可恢复；不能仅以数据库状态证明。

findings.title: decision_twin 未完整接入用户路径

findings.title: 申请级在线决策服务缺口
findings.closure_criterion: 真实服务复用既有评分与策略；幂等、原因码、版本、降级和已冻结SLO通过。

findings.title: KYC征信及实时反欺诈工作流缺口

findings.title: 催收动作尚不支持

claim_limits: No guarantee of universal autonomy or absence of future defects.
No production or causal benefit claim based only on historical replay or reference services.
Industry leadership requires independent comparative evidence and is not an acceptance result of this repository plan.

validation_rules: P requires institution_production target identity and verified real operation receipts; institution_test alone is insufficient.
H requires a user historical-data manifest and cannot use synthetic_fixture as the business evidence.
A requires a real model profile, real Executor and real Tool receipts.
C/R may use synthetic input, but R still requires actual application execution.
Closed rejects missing original evidence, hash/input/criterion mismatch or missing independent review.
evidence_record_contract.hash_map_format: source_hashes maps source-root-relative paths to SHA-256; dataset/input/artifact hashes map evidence-root-relative paths to SHA-256. Hashes prove binding, not execution. CLI has no trusted receipt/reviewer adapters and cannot authenticate closure.
evidence_record_contract.trust_rule: The ledger copy of the spec digest is descriptive only. The acceptance environment must independently supply the approved digest/spec and trusted receipt and review verifiers. Never derive trusted requirements from this candidate ledger.
